items.headline: Tower Semiconductor secures $1.3 billion in Silicon Photonics contracts for 2027 with $290 million in capacity-reservation prepayments and outlines 2028 financial model targeting $2.8 billion revenue and $750 million net profit

Tower Semiconductor announces dual-track strategic expansion of 300mm Silicon Photonics, Silicon Germanium and advanced packaging capacity in Japan, backed by approximately $1 billion in grants from the Government of Japan and about $3 billion of its own investment
Tower Semiconductor provides record Q2 2026 revenue guidance of $455 million (±5%) and reports strong cash generation alongside reaffirmed 'ilAA' rating with positive outlook from S&P Maalot
Tower Semiconductor shares rise 11.7% after strong Q1 results, upgraded forecasts, and long-term Silicon Photonics agreements totaling about $1.3 billion for 2027
